biotools.summary: Protrec2 is a probabilistic framework for missing protein recovery in proteomics that integrates tissue-specific protein complex annotations with Bayesian inference. It outperforms existing methods and has been validated on HeLa and A549 proteomes, demonstrating biological and clinical relevance.
